meta.name: Agent from Above
meta.description: Bound by a deity's pact, Han Chieh fights demons on Earth. When he uncovers an old enemy's plan for a second invasion, he must fight to save humanity.

videos.title: The Sinner
videos.overview: A young woman troubled by hauntings at home seeks help from a divine agent. He reluctantly agrees to investigate and allows her to assist him on a case.

videos.title: Karma
videos.overview: Yeh Tzu tags along on another case and proves helpful. Han Chieh realises that an old enemy is back.

videos.title: Soul Harvest
videos.overview: When a neighbor goes missing, Han Chieh takes a trip to find out what's going on. He uncovers something much more sinister and decides to take action.

videos.title: The Ghost Forge
videos.overview: More disappearances linked to the Demon King occur. Han Chieh confronts an old enemy, only to unearth a larger, looming evil.

videos.title: Into the Abyss
videos.overview: Recovering from battle, Han Chieh follows a message to a key location, leading him and Chang-min to surprising new leads in their hunt for answers.

videos.title: A Lifetime of Luck
videos.overview: As they close in on the new troublemaker in town, a lucky amulet causes some stir, so Han Chieh and Chang-min investigate its dark origins.

videos.title: The Descent
videos.overview: Yeh Tzu brings Han Chieh to a special spot to reflect before battle. Later, he faces a tough decision involving a huge sacrifice.

videos.title: Turning the Wheel
videos.overview: Chaos reigns under the full moon at Dongfeng Market. Han Chieh must rally all his allies to face pure evil, protect loved ones and save the world.
